title: Ctxo shadow-spec resolutions
description: <registry folder>/<context>/shadow-specs.yaml: resolutions of shadow-spec candidates by fingerprint (find_shadow_specs). One entry resolves every candidate with its fingerprint; an entry matching no candidate is stale.

fingerprint.description: <kind> | <symbol> | <normalized text>, as find_shadow_specs reports it; spacing around the separators does not matter.

rule.description: The rule that states this candidate (LEND-03; lend03 also works).

notARule.description: Why this candidate is not a business rule.
